title: Fernández-Díaz 2011 · Acoustic pointing with a bar
citation: Fernández-Díaz and Travieso (2011). Performance in haptic geometrical matching tasks depends on movement and position of the arms. Acta Psychologica, 136(3), 382–389.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.coordinate_frame: Lateral relative to table midline and depth from near edge, in cm.
published_method.bar_setup: 20 cm pivoted bar with 1.1 cm diameter and arrow-shaped ends on a magnetized steel table.
published_method.procedure: Blindfolded participant points the test bar at the active speaker during the noise, then lifts their hand at sound offset.
published_method.analysis: Continuous signed error relative to correct speaker direction from the bar pivot. Reverse left-hand pointing signs for ANOVA.
